target.title: docs(skills): add extended-stable backport workflow
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

OpenClaw's npm `extended-stable` maintenance process needs a repeatable way to discover the complete set of security and reliability fixes for the trailing completed month's core package. The source set must include direct commits and private security work, not only public PRs, while staying inside the npm-only publication boundary landed in #99352.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a manually invoked `$openclaw-extended-stable-backport` skill that resolves either the initial `.33` bootstrap or a later maintenance patch, inventories the full mainline delta in bounded batches, reconciles private advisories, carries unresolved candidates across runs, and prepares one approved multi-commit backport PR.

The workflow now treats `docs/reference/RELEASING.md` and `scripts/openclaw-npm-extended-stable-release.mjs` as the canonical contract. It uses the exact `extended-stable/YYYY.M.33` branch shape, separates the npm selector from the user-facing `stable` channel, enforces the protected-`main` month policy, and hands release execution back to `$release-openclaw-maintainer` for exact branch/tag/package identity plus the manual preflight, Full Release Validation, publish, readback, and selector-repair path.

The skill intentionally excludes separately published plugins, GitHub Releases, native apps, Docker, mobile, and website publication. Changes that require coordinated plugin publication are blocked rather than routed through the superseded unlanded stable-plugin planner assumptions.

## User Impact

No product runtime behavior changes. Maintainers gain a release-level workflow for discovering, reviewing, backporting, validating, and handing off the complete core npm patch set for the active or initial `extended-stable` line.

## Evidence

- Current head: `96b71615af4`.
- `python3 /Users/dallin/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/scripts/quick_validate.py .agents/skills/openclaw-extended-stable-backport`: passed.
- `pnpm docs:list`: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- Live npm/branch bootstrap probe on July 4, 2026 confirmed that `openclaw` currently has no `extended-stable` dist-tag and the repository currently has no `extended-stable/*` branch, so the skill includes an explicit maintainer-approved initial `.33` mode instead of assuming an already-published line.
- Compared the skill against the merged #99352 release contract, including the canonical branch, patch boundary, protected-`main` policy, npm-only scope, manual workflow evidence, registry readback, and selector repair behavior.
